articles.title: Report: Patriots sign rookie LB Gabe Jacas to four-year deal
articles.description:
Jacas, who was the only unsigned second-rounder in the NFL, reached a deal with the Patriots on the first day of training camp.

The post Report: Patriots sign rookie LB Gabe Jacas to four-year deal appeared first on Boston.com.
